history.name: Profit
history.content:
As of **early 2024**, here are the **approximate retail prices (MRP)** for Amul milk in India.  
**Prices vary by city/state** (due to local taxes, transport, and dealer margins) and can change every few months, so treat these as **ballpark figures** for the most common pack sizes.

| Variant (Fat %) | 500 ml | 1 Litre | 2 Litre | 6 Litre (Tetra) |
|-----------------|--------|---------|---------|-----------------|
| **Amul Gold (Full Cream, 6% fat)** | ₹30–₹32 | **₹60–₹64** | ₹120–₹128 | ₹360–₹380 |
| **Amul Taaza (Toned, 3% fat)** | ₹26–₹28 | **₹52–₹56** | ₹104–₹112 | ₹310–₹330 |
| **Amul Shakti (Double Toned, 1.5% fat)** | ₹24–₹26 | **₹48–₹52** | ₹96–₹104 | ₹285–₹305 |
| **Amul Slim & Trim (Skimmed, <0.5% fat)** | ₹24–₹26 | **₹48–₹52** | — | — |
| **Amul Cow Milk (≈4% fat)** | ₹28–₹30 | **₹56–₹60** | — | — |
| **Amul Buffalo Milk (≈6–7% fat, select markets)** | — | **₹62–₹68** | — | — |

### Quick notes
- **Most common purchase**: 1‑litre poly‑pack (the bold column above).  
- **Metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bangalore, etc.)** tend to be at the **higher end** of the range.  
- **Smaller towns / rural areas** may be a rupee or two cheaper.  
- **Tetra‑pak (UHT) versions** (e.g., 1 L Tetra) usually cost **₹2–₹4 more** than the fresh poly‑pack.  
- Prices are revised periodically (often quarterly) by GCMMF (Amul’s parent cooperative).

### How to get the exact price *right now*
1. **Check the pack** – MRP is printed on every poly‑pack/tetra.  
2. **Amul’s official app / website** – “Store Locator” often shows local MRP.  
3. **Quick‑commerce apps** (Blinkit, Zepto, BigBasket, Swiggy Instamart) – they list real‑time prices for your pincode.  
4. **Local dairy booth / kirana** – they’ll quote the current rate instantly.

If you tell me your **city or pincode**, I can point you to the quickest way to see today’s exact rate.
